instruction: Please act as a professional Verilog designer. Create a module that implements a digital system with four inputs (a,b,c,d) that generates a logic-1 when the input is a multiple of 3, and a logic-0 otherwise. You should design the module using a combinational circuit and optimize the output expression to minimize the number of gates.
original_rtl:
module digital_system (
  input a,
  input b,
  input c,
  input d,
  output reg out
);

  always @* begin
    if ((a+b+c+d)%3 == 0) begin
      out <= 1;
    end
    else begin
      out <= 0;
    end
  end
  
endmodule

end

end
end
